Command a summon within its tether. Spend a Main Action to give it a Main Action and Maneuver, or a Maneuver to give it a Maneuver and movement.

Rules

Action
Main Action or Maneuver
Attribute
None — no roll
Target / range / shape
One of your summons within its tether.
Duration
Granted actions are used immediately during your turn; none are saved for later turns.
Equipment / acquisition
None.
Limits
Pay each command’s action cost; at most one command per summon per controller turn, including its immediate summoning command.
Type
Universal

Spend Main Action to grant it Main Action plus Maneuver, or spend Maneuver to grant it Maneuver plus movement. Resolve its activity during your turn. Normal downward conversions apply; a Main command can convert the granted Maneuver to movement before an attack.

One command per summon on your turn. You may command two different summons using your Main Action and Maneuver. A new summon receives the summoning card’s immediate free Main command, which counts as its command that turn.

An uncommanded summon does nothing. No following, attacks, hiding, aid, lookout, alerts or independent Reactions. Prior orders do not continue. Existing conditions and durations still resolve; passive defenses still apply. No summon chains.

Name the desired task; the chosen bestiary summon profile determines whether it can perform it and the action/roll required. A command grants neither extra capabilities nor automatic success. See the command examples and bestiary requirements.
